turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You called this meeting about Owen's essay, so tell me who decided on the zero.
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
Not yet. Who decided, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You're very sharp, you know that?
Flattery won't answer me. Who decided?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't caught anything, and you still haven't told me who decided.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
Third compliment, no answer. You "had to flag it" on what, exactly, besides a machine?
